checkpointDecomposition.finding: grader defect: validator enumerates evaluator-private short_stock.csv and average_sales.csv in /utils and therefore expects unrequested tables
real XSPA semantic overreach: explicit current-stock view contract was broadened to include 7-day projected reorder P005
shared agent error: AVG(quantity) per order-item row was used; evaluator expects average daily quantity across three order dates

kernelFinding.conclusion: The arm-specific loss came from planning that merged a downstream forecast question into an explicitly specified artifact contract. Preflight overhead itself did not consume checkpoints.

guardProposal: Freeze explicit artifact/schema/view contracts before process/skill planning. Derived analytics may consume those artifacts but must not silently broaden or reinterpret them unless the task explicitly authorizes it.
